architecture.application: H2 facade coordinates guarded parse/project/owner read/material prepare
architecture.domain: C1 DesignDoc semantics; M04 unique authoritative content/history owner
architecture.driven: providers not implemented by this document
architecture.ownership: M04 content/revision/history; H2 ephemeral candidate handle only; M05 material issuer
architecture.transaction: Temporary parse/project, M04 owner read, M05 material read/resolve, verify captured read evidence and recheck authority, then proposed slot publication; no durable pin, content commit, root transfer, formal IO or ACK

contracts: Prepare never increments revision/history, marks dirty, emits edit event, or consumes candidate
Dependency missing returns typed DependencyNotReady, no fallback runtime
Late owner change rejects publication; no success disclosure
Raw inner source preserved independently of outer JSON fixture decoding

BDD_categories.B11: Deferred: compatibility needs adopted C1 and target versions

TDD.level: document model only, future L2 module contract/L3 native/L4 adjacent
TDD.valid_RED: Future product test compiles and fails on missing approved behavior; document checks/dependency absence are not RED

acceptance: Full roots validate under explicitly limited subset
Each new fixture compares complete response, state and call log
Seven typed domain diagnostics reject string fields
Proof substitutions reject against immutable capture
No product or old package changes
Independent reviewer remains distinct from author

choices.decision: Successful prepare replaces previous candidate slot only after all guards pass; failure retains old slot.
Retained exact request includes raw inner text, scoped to admitted owner generation. Same request with altered number lexeme is a conflict.

ReadResolved material evidence is an internal proposed fixture projection only, not an adopted M05 DTO, durable pin or root transfer. Missing provider returns DependencyNotReady. Install owns any later pin seam.

No TTL invented. Historical owner-binding.json /request_records retains until owner closed, 128 keys/binding and 1024 runtime; no eviction/time retry. Slot replacement and old candidate replay authority effects remain Owner decisions.

Inner checker covers only syntax, decoded duplicate, top-level shape, exact decimal and raw numeric token size for new fixtures. Existing C1 24+12 traced, not rerun. Full C1 resource/type/numeric representability and ESS projection remain dependencies.
Model trusts issuer lookup authenticity, dependency outcome and unsupported list; native pin issuance, provider registry and real owner proof remain unproved.

C1_trace.rerun: NOT RUN; not counted as progress

lifecycle.authority: main or ui-editor trusted local + existing project/document binding
lifecycle.result: one shared S1 owner, default writer caller; existing owner only grants read view until transfer

lifecycle.authority: current writer + owned unused candidate + same captured revision
lifecycle.result: S1 Edit commit once, revoke previews; failure no state change

lifecycle.authority: current writer + actual target window exists

lifecycle.result: close/drop owner; no autosave, no clear journal
revoke nonce and writer; prevent silent unsaved discard via CloseRequested confirmation; crash loss is not recovery proof
retire affected owner/candidate/preview; failed settings change leaves owner intact

lifecycle.authority: save or integrated formal load requested

limits: ESS projector and full C1 are fixture outcomes, not production implementations
Proof fixture authentic issuer lookup is a premise; no native security proof
No durable material pin is issued or verified by prepare model

tasks.scope: Exact accepted Port/provider envelope -> Skeleton -> compile -> valid RED

UI_schema.error: Keep active design and old candidate; show typed failure; late owner result suppressed

UI_schema.BDD_mapping: fixtures.json cases reference complete command request/response
